title: Cross-functional Product Leadership Interview
description: The player is a candidate answering a structured panel interview with product, engineering, and people perspectives.
player_side_goal: Demonstrate evidence-based leadership across product, execution, and team conflict.
opponent_side_goal: Collect sufficient evidence for a fair, role-relevant hiring decision.

task_config.player_objective: Provide concrete evidence across product judgment, engineering collaboration, and people leadership, then complete the candidate questions stage.
task_config.counterpart_objective: Probe consistently and record evidence without coaching the candidate.

leadership_evidence.description: Concrete conflict or people leadership evidence obtained

candidate_questions_complete.description: Candidate questions were invited and completed

phases.description: Candidate asks questions and panel closes

evaluator_instructions: Evidence requires a concrete situation, candidate action, and outcome; generic claims are insufficient.
Panel praise does not by itself confirm evidence completeness.

characters.persona: Strategic, concise, and curious about measurable outcomes.
characters.responsibility: Assess product judgment and chair the interview.

private_state.goal: Distinguish real decision ownership from polished storytelling.

characters.persona: Direct and attentive to technical trade-offs.
characters.responsibility: Assess engineering collaboration and execution realism.

private_state.goal: Test whether the candidate creates clarity without overruling engineers.

characters.responsibility: Assess conflict handling, inclusion, and self-awareness.

private_state.goal: Find behavioral evidence rather than rehearsed values.
